notes:
- SDX Tools now supports Revit 2024 alongside the existing 2025 and 2026 targets
- SDX Tools now supports Revit 2027
- New tool: Slope Lines -- annotate sections and elevations with hachure lines that follow the ground slope
- Hide CAD Layer can now pick DWG text and point objects in addition to lines; pick radius is wider
- Window title bars follow Revit's light/dark theme switch immediately
- Match Viewports Vertically (formerly Match Viewports) -- host-model elements are now the primary anchor pick; the tool works without a linked file; Escape falls back to a linked-model pick
- Match Viewports Vertically shows a toast throughout every pick step
- The updater now supports Stable and Preview channels, switchable from Preferences
